sentences.text: Shri Sidhharh Datt, Advocate for the appellant.
Shri A. N. Gupta, Public Prosecutor for the respondent
Heard on I.A.No.10697/2024, which is first application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C., for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant Rambabu Sahu S/o Shri Ramvishwas Sahu.

Appellant - Rambabu , is aggrieved of the judgment dated 17.10.2023, passed by the learned Special Judge, POCSO Act, 2012, District Satna (M.P.), in Special Case No.08/2022, whereby, appellant has been convicted for offence punishable under Section 363 & 376(2)(N) of IPC, for which no separate sentence is awarded, under Section 366 of IPC, he is sentenced to undergo R.I. for 3 years with fine of Rs.100/-, Section 376(3) of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 20 years with fine of Rs.1000/-
and Section 5(L) r/w Section 6 of POCSO Act
, he is sentenced to undergo R.I. for 20 years with fine of Rs.1,000/-, with default stipulation on each count.
It is submitted that reading evidence of father of the prosecutrix (PW/4), that he has stated in para 4 of his cross-examination that prosecutrix is his second number of child.
Elder daughter was married about four years prior to the date of deposition which is of 23.
He has admitted that age of the elder daughter is 23 years and the prosecutrix is just younger to the elder 2 CRA-14930-2023 daughter and is about 2-3 years younger to the elder daughter.
Thus, it is pointed out that prosecutrix was major on the date of the incident and it is a case of consent.

It is also pointed out that vide Ex.D/5,
he has been able to demonstrate that marriage of prosecutrix took place on 27.04.2022, i.e. just after five months of the incident which is again an indication that prosecutrix was major on the date of the incident.
School Teacher (PW/1), has not been able to prove the date of birth convincingly and there are several lacunas in her evidence.
Therefore, it is submitted that when age is doubtful, then benefit of doubt may accrue in favour of the appellant.
There are good chances of success.
It is submitted that appellant is in jail from 13.01.2022 till the date of judgment i.e. 17.10.2023, till date.
Hence, prayer is made to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant and release him on bail.

Taking these facts into consideration, fact of incarceration and other circumstances, it is directed that on depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only), with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on 02.04.2025 and such other dates as may be fixed by the Trial Court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence imposed upon Appellant - Rambabu Sahu, shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
3 CRA-14930-2023 I.A.No.10697/2024, is allowed & disposed of.
